title: F6 alt: YAR as positional cue (line-15 width hint)
hypothesis_summary: Alternative-mechanism reading of A5. F6-61/62 read YAR as numeric SHIFTS; this pack reads YAR as a POSITIONAL cue — the superscript marks 'something special at line 15'. Cipher-side line 15 width on the sculpture is 30 letters; the K4 ciphertext (97 chars) does not directly inherit the 30-wide grid, but width 15 (line index) and 30 (line width) are tested as columnar widths in this rival.

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: YAR superscript on line 15 of cipher-side panel.

composition_templates.rationale: Sub + columnar with widths drawn from line-15/line-width interpretation of YAR.

caveats: Width-30 is at the edge of the bounds-allowed range and produces 4-row grids; weak transposition diffusion.
